findings.scope: Held phase 452 H48/H64/H128; H64 nearby 430/440/464; H128 selected OBS off
findings.observation: R3 visibly pulls the long R2 lateral strips back toward the body. However two pale upward/outward tips and a central V-shaped opening still terminate the assembled lower body. The thin upper material reads as paired flared strips, particularly at H128, rather than a coherent continuous incoming cloth region beside its final body. H48/H64 retain a small fork silhouette.

findings.unresolved: Shorter span has reduced severity but not removed the forked strip morphology. Must establish actual body-adjacent material cohesion in this transition before judging the defect resolved.

findings.observation: 45 ms shows initial localized cyan emission;220 ms shows feet and a low incoming pale edge;430–464 show completed skirt/cape/sleeves below advancing cyan front with forked tips above.710 shows face beneath an incomplete paired hood-top;790/814 show complete face/hood/body. findings.limits: The lower assembled actor remains recognizably the same source in these sampled states. These images do not prove every row arrives without disappearance, exact alpha handoff,24 ms smooth fixation, no intervening pop, or conservation in motion.

findings.scope: H128 default/OBS off/source off 452; H64 timeline later phases through 1200
findings.observation: Default has bright white/cyan source front plus green near-field spread; OBS off removes much soft lateral spread while direct front and material tips remain. Source off returns original actor.710–865 show light near hood/crown;1050 retains smaller crown response;1199/1200 show original actor with no visibly persistent large glow.
findings.codeMeaningChecked: shader reconstruct sourceOn gates material reconstruction and radiation; no sourceOn returns original actor. present adds scene+direct emission+selected bloom, and observer coefficient applies only to bloom. Thus sourceoff is a combined effect/reconstruction bypass, not a pure emission-only diagnostic. OBS off keeps direct emission and reconstruction.
findings.readbackSupportingOnly: Native receipt source off 452 and1200 ms expiry has strict-zero emission; this review did not rerun GPU or independently measure response.
findings.limits: Sampled optical source/observer relationship is plausible. No normal-speed optical continuity, off→default restoration, target-hidden actual image, moving-camera/occlusion or hardware validation is accepted. Strong emission and white core are intentional and not defects; no blanket dimming recommendation.
